clips.title: The story
paras: Master Gadrin sends word from Sen'jin Village to Razor Hill about the Burning Blade. This early Horde dispatch carries a warning of demonic corruption spreading through Durotar.

Sen'jin Village faces its own troubles, especially Zalazane's treachery on the Echo Isles. Yet reports of the Burning Blade point to a danger far wider than the village's local woes. Demonic corruption was uncovered in the Valley of Trials, and Master Gadrin knows the threat cannot be met in isolation. He sends you north along the road to Razor Hill, where orc authorities watch over Durotar.

Orgnil Soulscar is stationed at Razor Hill's military encampment, charged with rooting out evils within Durotar and guarding its central lands. When you bring Gadrin's warning, Orgnil combines reports from Sen'jin Village and the Valley of Trials. The Burning Blade's reach is dangerously close, so he quickly mobilizes forces to break up the cultists before their rituals can unseat the young nation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid. But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

There is a traveler stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade! Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials. He will want to know these things.
Razor Hill lies to the north.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes? You have something to report? Well then, let's have it!
